2609.15740.title: A Language-Guided Multimodal Foundation Model for Zero-Shot and Multi-Task Brain Signal Analysis
2609.15740.paper_summary: Brain signal analysis is essential for both neuroscience research and clinical diagnostics, yet current approaches face critical limitations. End-to-end models require task-specific retraining and exhibit limited generalization, while pre-trained models lack semantic depth and still depend on extensive fine-tuning. Meanwhile, general-purpose multimodal foundation models, though powerful in other domains, struggle to interpret brain signals due to representational misalignment and lack of domain knowledge. This study introduces a multimodal foundation model for zero-shot and multi-task brain signal analysis (METIS) through a unified language-signal alignment framework. METIS is pretrained on the largest and most diverse brain-signal corpus to date, comprising over 70,000 h of recordings from more than 11,000 subjects across 20 datasets. In a comprehensive zero-shot evaluation across 12 datasets, METIS outperformed the leading generalist model by over 20.9% in average accuracy. Remarkably, without any fine-tuning, METIS's performance matches or exceeds that of supervised, task-specific models. Furthermore, METIS demonstrates exceptional data efficiency and strong generalization, achieving an average AUROC advantage of over 16.0% in few-shot settings and 15.9% in cross-dataset transfer. This work establishes a new paradigm for general-purpose brain signal analysis, paving the way for next-generation neurotechnology.
2609.15740.paper_summary_zh: 腦信號分析對於神經科學研究和臨床診斷至關重要，但當前的方法面臨著關鍵的限制。端到端模型需要特定任務的重新訓練，並且表現出有限的泛化能力，而預訓練模型缺乏語義深度，仍然依賴於大量的微調。與此同時，雖然通用的多模態基礎模型在其他領域中非常強大，但由於表徵不對齊和缺乏領域知識，這些模型在解釋腦信號方面遇到了困難。本研究通過統一的語言-信號對齊框架，引入了一種用於零-shot和多任務腦信號分析的多模態基礎模型（METIS）。METIS在迄今為止最大的、最具多樣性的腦信號語料庫上進行了預訓練，該語料庫包含來自20個數據集的超過70,000小時的錄音，涉及超過11,000名受試者。在對12個數據集進行的全面零-shot評估中，METIS在平均準確率上超越了領先的通用模型超過20.9%。值得注意的是，METIS在沒有任何微調的情況下，其性能與有監督的特定任務模型相當或更高。此外，METIS展現了卓越的數據效率和強大的泛化能力，在少量樣本設置中實現了超過16.0%的平均AUROC優勢，在跨數據集轉移中則為15.9%。這項工作為通用腦信號分析建立了一個新的範式，為下一代神經技術鋪平了道路。
